criteria.title: Pilot devices report a ZDX score
criteria.statement: Pilot devices report a ZDX score and the POV probes run.

criteria.title: A slow app is traced hop by hop, down to the cause
criteria.statement: For a pilot user's slow app, the console shows the hop-by-hop path from the device to the app with the device's Wi-Fi, CPU and memory, and names where the delay is.
criteria.attest: In ZDX, open the pilot user's device: show the app's hop-by-hop path (CloudPath) and device health, then degrade the Wi-Fi or throttle the link and show the score drop pinned to that hop.
